name: Bunny
role: A harmless critter that spawns in the Forest biome
spawnCondition: the critter The Bunny is a harmless critter that spawns in the Forest biome.
description: the critter The Bunny is a harmless critter that spawns in the Forest biome. They are the most common critters in Terraria, and are usually the first ones a new player will see. During a Blood Moon, or when hit with Vile Powder/Vicious Powder, Bunnies will turn into Corrupt Bunnies or Vicious Bunnies. During the Halloween seasonal event, Bunnies spawn wearing Green Slime costumes, during Christmas, Bunnies will spawn wearing Santa costumes, and during a Party, Bunnies can spawn with Party Hats. Gem Bunnies spawn near towns in the Cavern layer.

name: Old Man
role: An NPC whose primary function is to summon Skeletron, and can be found at the Dungeon's entrance
spawnCondition: The Old Man is an NPC whose primary function is to summon Skeletron, and can be found at the Dungeon's entrance.
description: The Old Man is an NPC whose primary function is to summon Skeletron, and can be found at the Dungeon's entrance. When spoken to at night, the Old Man will give the player the option to , which summons Skeletron. When spoken to during the day, the Old Man will tell the player to return at night. He will also judge players with 300 maximum health (15 hearts) or less, or 10 defense or less as unworthy, but still allows them to summon Skeletron. The Dungeon can be entered without defeating Skeletron, but traveling deeper than ground level within it (below zero depth) will spawn Dungeon Guardians that will most likely kill the player on contact (see Guide:Dungeon Guardian strategies). When Skeletron is defeated, the Old Man is freed from his curse and will arrive as the Clothier (as long as a vacant house is available), in addition to allowing access to the Dungeon.

name: Wizard
role: A Hardmode NPC vendor who sells magic-related items
spawnCondition: He will move in once the following criteria have been met: * There is an available vacant house.
description: The Wizard is a Hardmode NPC vendor who sells magic-related items. He will move in once the following criteria have been met: * There is an available vacant house. * Rescuing him as the Bound Wizard, who can be rarely encountered in the Cavern layer once the Wall of Flesh has been defeated. Interacting with him in this state with will free him. If the Bound Wizard is killed, he will still be able to respawn afterwards; if the Wizard NPC is killed, he will move in again after some time as long as there are vacant houses. The Wizard will defend himself against nearby enemies by casting fireballs similar to those of the Flower of Fire, which damage and inflict the On Fire! debuff on enemies for 5 seconds. He deals 18 / 27 / 31 damage at the start of the game, and gains various stat boosts as the player progresses. The Wizard occasionally replaces his regular quote with a comment about the player's luck, and this is the only way to estimate a player's luck value in the game.

name: Zoologist
spawnCondition: Arrives after you fill 10% of the Bestiary.
